title: Redwake Breaker
text: Redwake Breaker advances behind a slab shield while a piston maul clears the lane one impact at a time. On loss, suffer 1 Wound.
flavor: The shield is a door taken from the last place that resisted.

defeatReward.text: Redwake Breaker is defeated and its identifying marks are entered into your Trophy Pile.
